topic: Total revenue from an ice cream stand based on scoops sold
core_question: An ice cream stand sells scoops for $3.50 each. Find the total revenue from selling 24 scoops in an afternoon.
answer_summary: the total of $84 (24 scoops sold at $3.50 each)
